reason: A VS Code-style DSH web workbench centered on workspace file browsing, editing, previewing, and filesystem management, with documented full-access write operations that warrant human review.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 网页提供类似 VS Code 的工作区文件树、文本编辑与预览，以及文件和文件夹管理功能。
summaries.en: Adds a VS Code-style DSH web workbench for browsing, editing, previewing, and managing workspace files and folders.

capabilities: Create, edit, rename, copy, move, and delete files and folders
Preview text, Markdown, and image files
Synchronize open files with external disk changes
Open files and folders in the system file manager
Apply a layout patch to the DSH web interface
